correctness.rationale: For every prime p>=5, the projective coordinate p-cycle equalizer is Spec Z_(p)[lambda]/(lambda^p-1), parameterized by eigenvectors [1:lambda:...:lambda^(p-1)]. On it the cubic sum lambda^(3i+1) equals Phi_p(lambda) since 3 is a unit mod p, so the actual fixed scheme is precisely Spec Z_(p)[lambda]/Phi_p. This is monic finite flat rank p-1, with p-1 simple roots in characteristic zero, and F_p[t]/t^(p-1) at the special fiber. Phi_p(1+t) is Eisenstein at p and describes total ramification over Z_p. Gradient vanishing forces (-2)^p=1, impossible in characteristic zero and p>=5, so each fiber smooth. At [1:...:1] in characteristic p, tangent is im(tau-I)/ker(tau-I) for the regular p-Jordan block, giving a single block of size p-2. Independently checked prime p=5,7,11,13,17 with literal exponent permutation, Eisenstein coefficients and rank filtration; general proof is symbolic and all-prime.
